title: The Life and Death of Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日新闻简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上，现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将通过nytimes.com免费直播部分采访，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the life and death of Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi.
sentences.zh: 今天，阿布·贝克尔·巴格达迪的生与死。

sentences.en: My colleague, Natalie Kidroev, talks to Rukmini
sentences.zh: 我的同事娜塔莉·基德罗耶夫采访了鲁克米妮·

sentences.en: Kalamaki about the man who created ISIS.
sentences.zh: 卡拉马基，谈论这位ISIS的创始人。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, October 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月29日，星期二。

sentences.en: Rukmini, who was Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi?
sentences.zh: 鲁克米妮，阿布·贝克尔·巴格达迪是谁？

sentences.en: Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi was the caliph of the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 阿布·贝克尔·巴格达迪是“伊斯兰国”的哈里发。

sentences.en: He was the leader of this terrorist group that at its height controlled territory the size of Great Britain in Iraq and Syria that
sentences.zh: 他是这个恐怖组织的领导人，该组织在鼎盛时期控制了伊拉克和叙利亚境内相当于英国大小的领土，

sentences.en: drew in tens of thousands of recruits from 100 countries, 40,000, we believe, and that succeeded
sentences.zh: 吸引了来自100个国家的数万名新兵，我们认为有4万人，并且成功地

sentences.en: in carrying out attacks not just in Iraq and Syria, not just in Paris and Brussels, but in a total of, at the last count, I had 40 different countries around the world.
sentences.zh: 在世界各地发动了袭击，不仅是在伊拉克和叙利亚，不仅是在巴黎和布鲁塞尔，据我最后统计，总共涉及40个不同的国家。

sentences.en: So how does one become that?
sentences.zh: 那么一个人是如何变成那样的呢？

sentences.en: How do you become the leader of a caliphate?
sentences.zh: 你如何成为一个哈里发国的领导人？

sentences.en: What my reporting has shown is that it's actually not what people say it was.
sentences.zh: 我的报道显示，事实并非人们所说的那样。

sentences.en: People think that he was radicalized at Camp Bukha in the year 2004, which is right after the U.S.-led invasion of Iraq,
sentences.zh: 人们认为他在2004年，也就是美国领导的伊拉克战争爆发后不久，在布卡营被激进化，

sentences.en: when Baghdadi is picked up in a raid that was in fact aiming to get his brother-in-law.
sentences.zh: 当时巴格达迪是在一次旨在抓捕他姐夫的突袭中被捕的。

sentences.en: He is taken to an American facility, Camp Bukha.
sentences.zh: 他被带到了一个美国设施，布卡营。

sentences.en: And in Camp Bukha, the theory goes, he rubbed shoulders with the future leaders of the insurgency.
sentences.zh: 按照理论，在布卡营，他与叛乱组织的未来领导人们混在了一起。

sentences.en: And it was there that he became radicalized through those people and through his hatred of the American occupiers.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里，通过这些人以及他对美国占领者的仇恨，他变得激进起来。

sentences.en: This has been out in biographies of
sentences.zh: 这在关于

sentences.en: Baghdadi, said by the top analysts who are in this field.
sentences.zh: 巴格达迪的传记中都有记载，也是该领域顶尖分析师的观点。

sentences.en: But in fact, when you go and speak to the people who were incarcerated with him, you realize that he showed up already radicalized.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，当你去采访那些曾与他一同被监禁的人时，你会发现他到那里时就已经激进化了。

sentences.en: So in order to understand who he is, you have to back up and you have to go to, I would say, his childhood and his teenage years.
sentences.zh: 所以为了了解他是谁，你必须回溯，去了解他的童年和青少年时期。

sentences.en: And what was his childhood like?
sentences.zh: 他的童年是怎样的？

sentences.en: He came from a modest family from a village called Al-Jalam in central Iraq.
sentences.zh: 他来自伊拉克中部一个叫阿尔贾拉姆村的普通家庭。

sentences.en: This is a village located in what is known as the Sunni heartland of the country.
sentences.zh: 这个村庄位于该国所谓的逊尼派腹地。

sentences.en: And crucially, he came from a family that was from something called the Badri tribe in Al-Jalam.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，他来自阿尔贾拉姆一个叫巴德里部落的家庭。

sentences.en: And the Badri tribe traces its ancestry to the tribe of the Prophet Muhammad.
sentences.zh: 巴德里部落的祖先可以追溯到先知穆罕默德的部落。

sentences.en: Beyond all that, his family chose this one particular mosque that according to people that I spoke to in that neighborhood was not just any mosque.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，他的家人选择了这一座特定的清真寺，据我在那个社区采访的人说，这可不是普通的清真寺。

sentences.en: It was a
sentences.zh: 这是一座

sentences.en: Wahhabi mosque.
sentences.zh: 瓦哈比派清真寺。

sentences.en: The Wahhabi strain of Islam is one of the most hard line, the most austere, the most conservative.
sentences.zh: 瓦哈比派伊斯兰教是最强硬、最严苛、最保守的派别之一。

sentences.en: And early on in his upbringing, you see two things.
sentences.zh: 在他成长的早期，你可以看到两件事。

sentences.en: You see one, a real propensity towards religion, towards his faith.
sentences.zh: 一是，他对宗教、对信仰有着真正的倾向。

sentences.en: His childhood friends, his classmates, all talk about how they would be off on picnics.
sentences.zh: 他童年的朋友、同学都说他们会去野餐。

sentences.en: They'd be doing wheelies with their bikes in the street.
sentences.zh: 他们会在街上骑自行车玩特技。

sentences.en: And he was at the mosque.
sentences.zh: 而他却在清真寺里。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And the second thing that you hear about him around adolescence is that he starts to be
sentences.zh: 关于他青春期，你听到的第二件事是，他开始变得

sentences.en: outspoken when he sees people around him who are in some way violating what he believes to be
sentences.zh: 直言不讳，当他看到周围的人以某种方式违反他所认为的

sentences.en: Islamic law.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰教法时。

sentences.en: He gets into a big fight with his next door neighbor when his next door neighbor gets a tattoo.
sentences.zh: 当他的邻居纹身时，他与邻居大吵了一架。

sentences.en: Baghdadi was irate about that and he saw that as a violation of Sharia law.
sentences.zh: 巴格达迪对此非常愤怒，他认为这是对伊斯兰教法的亵渎。

sentences.en: And he let his neighbor know.
sentences.zh: 他让邻居知道了这一点。

sentences.en: He got bolder and bolder as he became older.
sentences.zh: 随着年龄的增长，他变得越来越大胆。

sentences.en: So in his later teenage years, he started to even abrade and reprimand people like the owner of the mosque that he attended.
sentences.zh: 所以在他十几岁后期，他甚至开始指责和训斥他所去清真寺的负责人。

sentences.en: This is somebody who was older than him and who was a mentor to him.
sentences.zh: 那个人比他年长，还是他的导师。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But he went so far as to chastise that man when he began smoking, telling him, quote,
sentences.zh: 但他甚至去责备那个男人抽烟，对他说，引用原话：

sentences.en: when you stand up and recite the prayer, the smell of your breath will make the angels fly away.
sentences.zh: “当你站起来诵经时，你呼吸的气味会让天使飞走。”

sentences.en: It sounds like Baghdadi is getting more and more dogmatic.
sentences.zh: 听起来巴格达迪变得越来越教条了。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: That certainly seems to be what people around him are noticing, but it's not yet at the point where it's really raising red flags.
sentences.zh: 这确实是周围人注意到的，但还没有到真正引起警觉的地步。

sentences.en: So he graduates high school.
sentences.zh: 他高中毕业了。

sentences.en: We were able to actually get his high school transcript.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上拿到了他的高中成绩单。

sentences.en: And from that, we gleaned that he was not a great student.
sentences.zh: 从中我们发现，他并不是一个好学生。

sentences.en: But even though he has these low grades, he manages to get into the University of Baghdad, specifically in their
sentences.zh: 但尽管成绩不好，他还是设法进入了巴格达大学，具体是在他们的

sentences.en: Islamic studies department and their Sharia law department.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰研究系和伊斯兰教法系。

sentences.en: And he begins a religious education.
sentences.zh: 他开始接受宗教教育。

sentences.en: He doesn't have a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 他没有多少钱。

sentences.en: And so he's supporting himself by teaching Quranic classes and later by becoming a preacher and an imam at a local mosque.
sentences.zh: 所以他靠教授古兰经课程维持生计，后来成为当地清真寺的传教士和伊玛目。

sentences.en: And it's at this local mosque that another trait of Baghdadi comes to light.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个当地清真寺，巴格达迪的另一个特质显露了出来。

sentences.en: People always described him as shy, as reserved, as taciturn.
sentences.zh: 人们总是形容他害羞、内敛、沉默寡言。

sentences.en: But by this point, he's now in his early 20s.
sentences.zh: 但此时他已经20出头了。

sentences.en: And these qualities that perhaps were seen as weaknesses when he was a child, they're now being interpreted as a sign of discipline,
sentences.zh: 这些在童年时期可能被视为弱点的品质，现在被解读为纪律的象征，

sentences.en: a sign of somebody who doesn't have a loose tongue, who says only exactly what he has to say and nothing more.
sentences.zh: 是一个口风严谨的人的象征，他只说必须说的话，不多说一句。

sentences.en: It's around this time as well, that he creates a soccer team that he becomes the coach of.
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，他组建了一支足球队并担任教练。

sentences.en: Wait, he's a soccer coach?
sentences.zh: 等等，他是足球教练？

sentences.en: He's a soccer coach.
sentences.zh: 他是足球教练。

sentences.en: And he was actually a pretty good player based on what other people said.
sentences.zh: 根据其他人的说法，他其实还是个不错的球员。

sentences.en: And I get that there's some dissonance there.
sentences.zh: 我明白这其中存在一些不协调。

sentences.en: Jihadist groups have in the past declared soccer to be something that was haram, forbidden.
sentences.zh: 圣战组织过去曾宣布足球是“哈拉姆”，即被禁止的。

sentences.en: But there it was.
sentences.zh: 但事实就是这样。

sentences.en: He was a good soccer player.
sentences.zh: 他是个不错的足球运动员。

sentences.en: He enjoyed playing soccer.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢踢足球。

sentences.en: But here's the twiSt. I spoke to members of his soccer team.
sentences.zh: 但转折点在这里。我采访了他足球队的成员。

sentences.en: And what's interesting is they said that they would play soccer.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，他们说他们会踢足球。

sentences.en: And at the end of the practice, he would call them all together.
sentences.zh: 练习结束后，他会把他们召集在一起。

sentences.en: And at that point, he would start handing out leaflets that were trying to propagate the tenets of Wahhabi Islam.
sentences.zh: 那时，他会开始分发传单，试图传播瓦哈比派伊斯兰教的教义。

sentences.en: And one young man that I spoke to, he was a teenager back when this occurred.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的一位年轻人，当时还是个十几岁的少年。

sentences.en: He brought this pamphlet home to his family.
sentences.zh: 他把这本小册子带回了家。

sentences.en: And his parents flew into a rage and pulled him from the soccer team because they saw this as something inappropriate and as something that could be dangerous for their son.
sentences.zh: 他的父母勃然大怒，让他退出了足球队，因为他们认为这不合适，而且可能对他们的儿子很危险。

sentences.en: So he was out of step, I think, with the culture around him.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他与周围的文化格格不入。

sentences.en: And it also sounds like he was even then willing to take risks to be spreading these very hardline beliefs.
sentences.zh: 听起来即使在那个时候，他也愿意冒险去传播这些非常强硬的信仰。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: More and more as he's becoming an adult, you're seeing a man who isn't able to sit on the sidelines and just live his own faith in a private manner.
sentences.zh: 随着他成年，你越来越能看到一个无法袖手旁观、无法以私下方式践行信仰的人。

sentences.en: He needs to co-opt people and turn them over to his interpretation of Islam.
sentences.zh: 他需要拉拢他人，让他们转而接受他所理解的伊斯兰教。

sentences.en: And he feels a need to police the faith of others, a need to tell others how to be good Muslims, and a need to call out what he perceived as transgressions against that faith.
sentences.zh: 他感到有必要监管他人的信仰，有必要告诉别人如何做一个好穆斯林，并有必要指出他所认为的对信仰的亵渎。

sentences.en: Okay, so what happens next?
sentences.zh: 好的，那接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: In 2003, America begins an invasion of Iraq with its coalition partners.
sentences.zh: 2003年，美国与其联盟伙伴开始入侵伊拉克。

sentences.en: People were dispersing.
sentences.zh: 人们四散奔逃。

sentences.en: Nobody wanted to be in Baghdad at this point in time because they were expecting that there were going to be strikes and bombardments.
sentences.zh: 当时没有人想待在巴格达，因为他们预计会有空袭和轰炸。

sentences.en: He goes back to Samara, allegedly, and less than a year later, in early 2004, he's picked up in Fallujah at the home of his brother-in-law, who at that
sentences.zh: 据称他回到了萨马拉，不到一年后，即2004年初，他在费卢杰他姐夫的家中被捕，他姐夫当时

sentences.en: point had picked up guns against the American occupation.
sentences.zh: 已经拿起武器反抗美国占领。

sentences.en: The way it's been described to me is that he was essentially picked up almost by mistake.
sentences.zh: 我得到的描述是，他基本上是几乎被误抓的。

sentences.en: He was a hanger-on to his brother-in-law who had become radicalized.
sentences.zh: 他只是跟着已经激进化的姐夫混。

sentences.en: So the first thing that happens, according to his fellow prisoners, is that he was named the emir of their tent.
sentences.zh: 所以据他的狱友说，发生的第一件事就是他被任命为他们帐篷的埃米尔。

sentences.en: At Camp Puka, there were specific tents that had dozens of prisoners each, and he gets named the emir of his tent.
sentences.zh: 在布卡营，有特定的帐篷，每个帐篷里有几十名囚犯，他被任命为他那个帐篷的埃米尔。

sentences.en: And under his emirship, he very quickly starts to incite violence against Shia prisoners that are being held inside this compound, to the point that Shia prisoners who
sentences.zh: 在他的领导下，他很快开始煽动针对关押在这个营地里的什叶派囚犯的暴力，以至于被关押在那里的什叶派囚犯

sentences.en: were incarcerated there began to clamor at the gates asking the Americans to be moved.
sentences.zh: 开始在门口大声疾呼，要求美国人把他们转移走。

sentences.en: Once the Shias were mostly removed from his tent, he then turned his attention to his fellow Sunnis, and he began actively policing the way that they practiced their faith.
sentences.zh: 一旦什叶派大多被从他的帐篷中移走，他就把注意力转向了他的逊尼派同胞，并开始积极监管他们践行信仰的方式。

sentences.en: Why is your beard so short?
sentences.zh: 为什么你的胡子这么短？

sentences.en: How many times did you pray today?
sentences.zh: 你今天祈祷了几次？

sentences.en: Why didn't you fast?
sentences.zh: 为什么不斋戒？

sentences.en: It's the middle of Ramadan, and so on.
sentences.zh: 现在是斋月期间，等等。

sentences.en: One anecdote that I was told is they caught somebody smoking in their tent, and Baghdadi gave the order that he needed to be held
sentences.zh: 我听到的一个轶事是，他们抓到有人在帐篷里抽烟，巴格达迪下令必须将他按住，

sentences.en: down, and two of his fingers were cut off with a shank that had been made from the metal inside the air conditioning unit that they had in their tent.
sentences.zh: 并用他们帐篷里空调机里的金属制成的尖刀切掉了他的两根手指。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah, and interestingly, that punishment, cutting off the two fingers that held the cigarette butt, that is a punishment that I later heard about in
sentences.zh: 是的，有趣的是，那种惩罚，切掉拿烟蒂的两根手指，是我后来在

sentences.en: Mosul from people who were accused of smoking under ISIS.
sentences.zh: 摩苏尔从那些在ISIS统治下被指控抽烟的人那里听到的惩罚。

sentences.en: So that seems pretty extreme.
sentences.zh: 这看起来相当极端。

sentences.en: I mean, how rare is this kind of behavior in the camp?
sentences.zh: 我是说，这种行为在营地里有多罕见？

sentences.en: I think it's very extreme, and I think that it points to an evolution that happened before he got to Camp Bucca, because that's a pretty out there place to be,
sentences.zh: 我认为这非常极端，而且我认为这指向了他在到达布卡营之前就已经发生的演变，因为那是一个相当离谱的地方，

sentences.en: to be doing that kind of thing in 2004, in Camp Bucca.
sentences.zh: 在2004年的布卡营做那种事。

sentences.en: How does he get out of this camp?
sentences.zh: 他是怎么离开这个营地的？

sentences.en: The Americans let him out end of 2004, less than a year after they captured him.
sentences.zh: 美国人在2004年底，也就是抓捕他不到一年后就把他放了。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, at that point in time, the American-led coalition had far bigger probleMs.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，当时美国领导的联军有更大的麻烦。

sentences.en: This has been tough weeks in that country.
sentences.zh: 那是该国艰难的几周。

sentences.en: Coalition forces have encountered serious violence in some areas of Iraq.
sentences.zh: 联军部队在伊拉克的一些地区遭遇了严重的暴力事件。

sentences.en: Our military commanders report that this violence is being instigated by three groups.
sentences.zh: 我们的军事指挥官报告说，这种暴力是由三个组织煽动的。

sentences.en: There was an insurgency that was exploding all over Iraq.
sentences.zh: 当时伊拉克各地爆发了叛乱。

sentences.en: Some remnants of Saddam Hussein's regime,
sentences.zh: 萨达姆·侯赛因政权的一些残余势力，

sentences.en: along with Islamic militants, have attacked coalition forces in the city of Fallujah.
sentences.zh: 连同伊斯兰武装分子，袭击了费卢杰的联军部队。

sentences.en: Terrorists from other countries have infiltrated Iraq to incite and organize attacks.
sentences.zh: 来自其他国家的恐怖分子渗透到伊拉克，煽动并组织袭击。

sentences.en: Suicide bombs were going off, hundreds of people were getting killed, and they were busy trying to contain the chaos that had been unleashed in this country.

sentences.en: military, has announced that they believe that he is dead.
sentences.zh: 军方第一次宣布他们相信他已经死了。

sentences.en: So I do think this is a big blow for ISIS.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实认为这对ISIS是一个沉重的打击。

sentences.en: And I would say that in some ways, it might even be a bigger deal than losing the territorial caliphate.
sentences.zh: 我想说，在某些方面，这甚至可能比失去领土哈里发国更重要。

sentences.en: The issue is that ISIS became so interwoven with this man through this ritual of having their fighters declare allegiance to him and to him alone.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，ISIS通过让战士们向他个人宣誓效忠的仪式，与这个人紧密地交织在一起。

sentences.en: So I think that this is going to be disorienting for their fighters.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这会让他们的战士感到迷茫。

sentences.en: And in the succession battle that is now most likely going to unfold, we know that according to their own reading of scripture, in order to be a caliph,
sentences.zh: 在现在很可能展开的继任之争中，我们知道根据他们对经文的解读，要成为哈里发，

sentences.en: you have to be descended from the tribe of the prophet Muhammad.
sentences.zh: 你必须是先知穆罕默德部落的后裔。

sentences.en: There are plenty of militants.
sentences.zh: 有很多武装分子。

sentences.en: According to the Pentagon, there might be as many as 18,000 members of ISIS still remaining just in Iraq and Syria.
sentences.zh: 据五角大楼称，仅在伊拉克和叙利亚，可能仍有高达18000名ISIS成员。

sentences.en: But only a small number of those 18,000 are directly descended from the tribe of the prophet Muhammad.
sentences.zh: 但这18000人中只有少数人是先知穆罕默德部落的直系后裔。

sentences.en: So you now have a much smaller pool of people that you can choose from.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在可以选择的人选范围小得多了。

sentences.en: Given that the bench is now so obscure, it's unclear whether the new person is going to be able to rise to the stature and have this cohesive effect over the group as he had.
sentences.zh: 鉴于现在的人选如此默默无闻，不清楚新人是否能够达到他那样的地位，并对该组织产生同样的凝聚力。

sentences.en: Rukmini, if we step back and look at how dramatically the politics in Syria have changed over the past month, we've seen the president pulling U.S.
sentences.zh: 鲁克米尼，如果我们退后一步，看看过去一个月叙利亚的政治发生了多么剧烈的变化，我们看到总统撤出了美国

sentences.en: troops out, seemingly allowing Turkey to attack our Kurdish partners on the ground.
sentences.zh: 军队，似乎允许土耳其攻击我们在地面上的库尔德伙伴。

sentences.en: What does this raid mean in the context of that massive shift?
sentences.zh: 这次突袭在那种巨大转变的背景下意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, I think that this raid was rushed as a result of the chaos that has now descended on this corner of the world as a result of American foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这次突袭是仓促进行的，因为美国外交政策导致这个世界角落陷入了混乱。

sentences.en: I know from my sources that it wasn't supposed to happen right now.
sentences.zh: 我从我的消息来源得知，它本不应该现在发生。

sentences.en: And I know from them that they had to hurry up and get their acts together because of a fear that as American forces pull out,
sentences.zh: 我从他们那里得知，他们必须赶紧行动，因为担心随着美军撤出，

sentences.en: as we lose the human intelligence that we had set up there, that we would essentially lose eyes on him.
sentences.zh: 随着我们失去在那里建立的人力情报，我们基本上会失去对他的监视。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so, to me, it feels like we're seeing a replay of 2011 all over again.
sentences.zh: 所以，对我来说，感觉我们正在重演2011年的一切。

sentences.en: In 2011, we thought that this group had been defeated and American forces pulled out and they announced that they were pulling out.
sentences.zh: 在2011年，我们认为这个组织已经被击败，美军撤出了，他们宣布他们正在撤出。

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: the insurgent group knew that all it has to do is sit tight for a little bit and pretty soon American forces were going to be out of their way and they were going to be face to face with Iraqi forces who,
sentences.zh: 叛乱组织知道它所要做的就是静观其变，很快美军就会离开，他们将不得不面对伊拉克军队，

sentences.en: even though they were well equipped, were not able to contain what came after.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们装备精良，却无法遏制后来发生的事情。

sentences.en: And I think we're doing exactly the same thing now.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们现在正在做完全一样的事情。

sentences.en: We are leaving this area of the world in chaos.
sentences.zh: 我们正在让这个地区陷入混乱。

sentences.en: We're taking our eyes off of it.
sentences.zh: 我们正在把目光从它身上移开。

sentences.en: And it's as if you've put a pot on the fire and at the moment when you turn your back, it's not yet boiling, but you walk away and go do something else.
sentences.zh: 这就好比你把锅放在火上，转身的那一刻水还没开，但你走开了，去忙别的事了。

sentences.en: And 10 minutes later, that pot is going to be boiling.
sentences.zh: 十分钟后，那锅水就会烧开了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Rukmini.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，鲁克米尼。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是今天你需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, House Democrats changed course and said they would take a formal vote on an impeachment inquiry after repeatedly resisting calls for one.
sentences.zh: 周一，众议院民主党人改变了方针，表示在多次抵制相关呼吁后，他们将对弹劾调查进行正式投票。

sentences.en: So far, the impeachment inquiry has deliberately proceeded without such a vote, inviting criticism from congressional Republicans and President Trump,
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，弹劾调查一直是在没有此类投票的情况下刻意进行的，这招致了国会共和党人和特朗普总统的批评，

sentences.en: who claim that the process is secretive and illegitimate.
sentences.zh: 他们声称这一程序是秘密且非法的。

sentences.en: But it now appears that House Speaker Nancy Pelosi believes that there is sufficient support for such a vote,
sentences.zh: 但现在看来，众议院议长南希·佩洛西认为进行此类投票的支持率已经足够，

sentences.en: that it would give the inquiry greater credibility and that it would set forth rules for a more public phase of the impeachment, including open hearings.
sentences.zh: 这不仅能赋予调查更高的可信度，还能为弹劾的公开阶段（包括公开听证会）制定规则。

sentences.en: And at least two wildfires in or near major California cities intensified on Monday, forcing large-scale evacuations.
sentences.zh: 周一，加州主要城市内或附近的至少两场野火加剧，迫使当地进行大规模疏散。

sentences.en: The sky is on fire right now.
sentences.zh: 天空现在看起来像着火了一样。

sentences.en: Embers raining down all around us now.
sentences.zh: 余烬正像雨点一样在我们周围落下。

sentences.en: Look at all the spot fires it just handled just now.
sentences.zh: 看看刚才处理掉的所有那些零星火点。

sentences.en: The Kincade Fire in Sonoma County, north of San Francisco, has doubled in size in 24 hours, burning at least 66,000 acres, an area nearly twice the size of San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 位于旧金山以北索诺玛县的“金凯德”大火在24小时内规模翻了一番，烧毁了至少6.6万英亩土地，面积几乎是旧金山市的两倍。

sentences.en: In anticipation of the fires, California's largest utility, PG&E, preemptively shut off power to more than 900,000 homes over the weekend, then restored it to some,
sentences.zh: 为应对火灾，加州最大的公用事业公司太平洋天然气和电力公司（PG&E）周末预先切断了超过90万户家庭的电力供应，随后又恢复了部分供电，

sentences.en: and is now expected to once again cut power to 500,000 customers later today.
sentences.zh: 预计今天晚些时候将再次切断50万用户的电力供应。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的需求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物不耐受吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
